title: cynoglossum asperrimum var. tosaense
intro: Cynoglossum asperrimum var. tosaense, commonly known as Japanese Hound's Tongue, is a plant species within the borage family (Boraginaceae). It has been traditionally used in Japanese medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat digestive issues, fever, and inflammation. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Cynoglossum asperrimum var. tosaense include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
